result.title: CME-SpectrumBench: Can LLMs Analyze Condensed Matter Spectral Data?
result.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are presently well assessed by expert-level mathematics and physics benchmarks which focus on theoretical, symbolic reasoning. However, we lack experimental benchmarks that evaluate data analysis in frontier research problems, a capability that future domain-specific foundation models must have. To this end, we present CME-SpectrumBench, an expert-designed benchmark consisting of 190 questions that measures how reliably frontier LLMs analyze research-level spectral scientific data in condensed matter experiments (CME). Using simulated CME spectral data, we prompt models to identify structures from 2D intensity arrays in the face of noise and limited instrumental resolution, a test of dense context reasoning. Models are scored by how accurately their numerical answers approach the ground truth. Under direct query, scores generally pale in comparison to handwritten code due to clear failure modes: models can find simple features but struggle to trace patterns or compute derived quantities, and performance typically degrades with increased data resolution and noise/convolution levels. LLM performance becomes comparable to handwritten code by allowing tool use (access to a Python interpreter) with/without ReAct prompting, in effect mapping questions onto agentic code generation problems. Our findings show that frontier models can serve as research assistants by interfacing with data through code, but still face difficulties processing information directly from large datasets - a key barrier future foundation models must overcome. The code and data are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/jingene/CMESpectrumBench.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 CME-SpectrumBench，用 190 道专家设计题目评测前沿 LLM 分析凝聚态实验光谱数据的能力：在噪声与有限仪器分辨率下从 2D 强度数组中识别结构并给出数值答案，结果发现直接问答弱于手写代码，且高分辨率、高噪声会加剧性能下降，允许调用 Python 解释器（可加 ReAct）后接近手写代码水平。
AI.relevance_reason: 作为面向研究级数据视觉分析的诊断型基准，它报告模型能找简单特征却难以追踪复杂模式、计算派生量，提示直接读取高密度数据的内部状态受限而依赖代码旁路，与视觉细节保留、视觉旁路和证据获取问题相关；但未涉及 latent 推理状态，且输入形式（图像还是数值数组）与「dense context reasoning」具体含义可供核查。
